notes: new_room: Danger.for_a_new_room for a story id, its clock in seconds and how many rooms it already has. monstrous: Danger.monstrous? thrown `throws` times in a row on Danger.generator_for(room). in_a_place: on Random.new(seed), Danger.in_a_place then Danger.hazard_in_a_place for each storey in `storeys` in turn, on one generator; output is one {danger, hazard, hazard_die} per storey, hazard and hazard_die null when none.
